nodes.label: Perspective Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Overlapping lessons update an existing perspective instead of creating near-duplicates that dilute reviewer attention.

nodes.label: Parallel Reviewers
nodes.rationale: Independent review dimensions are spawned concurrently, then their findings are deduplicated by root cause and location.

nodes.label: Report-Only Review
nodes.rationale: The review reports issues but does not edit files, push commits, or post PR comments unless separately requested.

nodes.label: Review PR
nodes.rationale: Reviews a pull-request diff through generic engineering dimensions and relevant repository-specific perspectives without modifying code or posting comments.

nodes.label: Review Uncommitted Changes
nodes.rationale: Reviews staged, unstaged, and relevant untracked working-tree files through generic and project-specific lenses without mutation.

nodes.label: Update Agent Skills Workflow
nodes.rationale: Weekly or manually triggered automation checks for skill updates, applies them on a branch, and opens an automated pull request when changes exist.

nodes.label: Real S3 Endpoint Verification
nodes.rationale: Release validation must use a signed build with real credentials, Keychain, and iCloud rather than relying only on DemoBucket UI fixtures.

nodes.label: Test-Driven Development
nodes.rationale: The repository requires a failing test, minimal implementation, passing tests, and refactoring.

nodes.label: Contribution Workflow
nodes.rationale: Non-trivial changes begin with an issue or discussion, proceed through a focused topic branch, and include tests or documentation when appropriate.

nodes.label: Security Issue Reporting
nodes.rationale: Security vulnerabilities should not be disclosed in public issues and should follow the private reporting instructions.

nodes.label: Private Vulnerability Reporting
nodes.rationale: Vulnerabilities should be reported through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, or privately to maintainers if unavailable.

nodes.label: Sakoku Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs the sakoku action for pull requests targeting main and manual dispatches with read-only repository contents.

nodes.label: Review-Time Detectability
nodes.rationale: A gap becomes a perspective only if a reviewer could have found it by reading the original diff.

nodes.label: Runtime-Only Gap
nodes.rationale: Production-load races and external behavior changes are reported but not converted into diff-checkable review perspectives.

nodes.label: Least-Privilege Review Credentials
nodes.rationale: App Review should use a throwaway bucket and credentials restricted to the operations the reviewer needs.

nodes.label: Improve Review from PR Gap
nodes.rationale: Turns a merged-PR oversight and its fix into a reusable review perspective only when the gap was detectable from the original diff.

nodes.label: Improve Review from Session
nodes.rationale: Mines bugs, corrections, constraints, and repeated friction from the current conversation and turns durable lessons into review checks.
